ctx.x: Yeah, the band. That's what it was, and I didn't want to get rid of it. It had Willie. Willie was standing over the slide, and Buddy Bowden, and all of them. But I didn't get it back, and I often wondered what to come up. And I went down there, and we hunted, we hunted. Nobody knowed him. Mm-hmm. But I had that dress, you understand?
Yeah, it was right there, 1400 St. Bernard.
